cohort: IIEST Yadav and Rathor 2020 small bone-X-ray set

primary_source.citation: D. P. Yadav and S. Rathor, Bone Fracture Detection and Classification using Deep Learning Approach, 2020 International Conference on Power Electronics & IoT Applications in Renewable Energy and its Control (PARC), 2020, pp. 282-285.
primary_source.evidence_note: The BTXRD dataset paper's review table and text describe the IIEST set as 217 2D X-rays: 49 healthy, 99 fractured, and 69 cancerous. It notes the small size.

screen.potential_endpoint: At most a small broad cancer-vs-noncancer screen; do not assume class definitions or reference-standard compatibility.
screen.access_status: No verifiable official image package or image-level manifest located in this review.
screen.rights_status: Dataset-level license and per-image reuse rights were not verified. Article publication/access terms do not by themselves grant rights to underlying images.
screen.reference_standard_status: The source checked here is a brief conference dataset description cited by the BTXRD paper; label provenance and independent diagnostic adjudication are not established.
screen.independence_status: Single-institution source is described. Image-level overlap with BTXRD sources or the BoneScope checkpoint/pretraining cannot be audited without a manifest.

decision_rationale: Only 69 cancer-labelled images are described, and the set also contains fracture images; the full set is not a tumor-specific cohort.
No verified downloadable package, per-image rights grant, or patient/image manifest was found.
The diagnostic reference standard and label adjudication are not sufficiently characterized for an external validation claim.
Potential overlap with BTXRD and BoneScope training/pretraining is unresolved.
limitations: Literature screening only. This record does not establish that the images are currently accessible, licensed for reuse, independent, or clinically suitable.
